t.E501.agn: In 1965, JECFA set the ADI for potassium hydrogen carbonate as 'not limited', within the group ADI for hydrogen carbonates. In the EU, as a Group I additive, it may be used at quantum satis (as much as needed).
t.E501.found.0: May be used at quantum satis (as much as needed) in many foods in the EU
t.E501.prod: It is produced by the chemical reaction of potassium hydroxide or potassium chloride with carbon dioxide.
t.E501.regx.0: ADI 'not limited' for potassium hydrogen carbonate.
t.E501.regx.1: Group I additive; generally permitted at quantum satis (as much as needed).
t.E501.summary: Potassium carbonates. Used as a raising agent and acidity regulator; in cocoa processing it darkens the colour.
t.E501.what: Potassium carbonate and potassium bicarbonate; used as an acidity regulator, raising agent and buffer.
